source.missionIDs: Official mission _key values of CCP SDE build 3405148, table missions (every ID checked to exist there).
source.levels: Owner-recorded level of a basic mission, extracted from the repository owner's EveJS mission authority table (level, provenance class and confidence only).
source.exception: Committed by the repository owner's approval (2026-10-11) as an exception to the rule against committing client-derived and captured-log data. Limited to the four fields in each row. No name, message text, reward, dungeon content or other CCP string is in this file.
source.reason: The client exporter that generated the client-derived values is not available in any repository on this machine, so the values cannot be regenerated; this file is the only record of them.

provenanceClasses.client: Level from the client dungeon difficulty or a level in the client dungeon name (CCP client data).
provenanceClasses.tq-log: Level from the captured TQ logs of the owner's golden security missions.
provenanceClasses.wiki: Level from an EVE University wiki table (distribution mission reports, mission chains), transcribed by the owner.
provenanceClasses.rule: Level from an owner rule or default (cargo-volume band, related chain, default level 1). Rule confidence is low or medium.
provenanceClasses.owner: Reserved for an owner-supplied tag file named by EVE_MISSION_LEVEL_TAGS (not in this file).
